title: Motion Hearing (General Domestic Relations Motion)
what_it_is: A hearing on a filed motion asking the court for a specific order. State the requested order in one sentence before the history; a brief is required only when the motion presents an issue of law (MCR 2.119(A)(2)).
who_is_in_the_room: The judge (or a referee, if the motion was referred - see the referee-hearing event).
You and the other party (or counsel).
Possibly Friend of the Court staff, if support/parenting time is at issue.
sequence: Motion, brief (if needed), notice of hearing, affidavit/verified statement (if facts are not already of record), and proof of service are filed and served (MCR 2.119(A)-(B); MCR 2.107(D)).
The response is due on the timeline in MCR 2.119(C) unless the court sets a different time.
Genesee LCR 2.119: a concurrence certificate and proposed order typically travel with the motion - PROVISIONAL, confirm current local practice.
The hearing proceeds: state the requested order in one sentence, then the material facts in date order with exhibits.
The court rules, or takes the matter under advisement.
prepare: Three specific asks with a source citation for each.
The signed proposed order, ready to hand up.
Confirm the hearing notice's place, time, and remote-appearance instructions.

applicable_rules.summary: A motion must state the grounds, the authority, and the relief sought, and be signed.
A brief is required when the motion presents an issue of law.
Sets the response/service timing for a motion unless the court sets a different time.
An affidavit must be made on personal knowledge and show the affiant is competent to testify.

traps.trap: A long history instead of the one-sentence requested order first.
traps.safe_move: Lead with the narrow request; a 20-minute hearing plan gives the material facts second (L1 guide).
The FOC may decline to enforce a term that is not enforceable (MCL 552.641(2)(c), quoted in M12). Write specific, enforceable terms.

traps.trap: Filing without the Genesee concurrence certificate or proposed order, if locally required.
traps.safe_move: PROVISIONAL - confirm current Genesee LCR 2.119 practice with the clerk before filing.

traps.trap: Signing your own verification without reading MCR 1.109(D)(3)(b)'s exact declaration language.
traps.safe_move: Copy the declaration language exactly; a knowingly false verification carries contempt exposure.

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Write down the date, who appeared, and what was decided or taken under advisement before leaving the building.
Write on any document handed to you the date you received it - that date can start a clock.
Calendar every deadline this event started, counted from the earliest possible trigger date.
Note whether anything was requested that you did not have time to answer fully, and follow up in writing.
